raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

**Closing this draft:** full-model hidden-state extraction now works on unmodified main. The remaining memory-sizing and CUDA-graph improvements are deferred to prioritize enabling extraction for other models. See the updated evidence in #59024.

Keep GLM-5.3-Flash hidden-state extraction within the native packed BLHNC cache stride and preserve MRV2 piecewise CUDA graphs. Follows up on #59024, updating this existing draft rather than creating a duplicate. Basic extraction now works on main, these changes address memory use and graph selection.

## Claims

- Size hidden-state blocks to fit native packed pages while preserving block-size divisibility.
- Allow the connector to read logical cache views with either LBNHC or BLHNC strides.
- Retain MRV2 breakable graphs when cache-only attention rules out full capture.

## Validation

- Rebased onto main at `258b97ff6b`, with exactly two commits. All pre-commit hooks passed.
- Current-main B300 validation: `~/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_utils.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_hidden_states_connector.py -q`: 180 passed.
- `~/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_config.py -k resolve_cudagraph_mode -q`: 12 passed.
- `~/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/extract_hidden_states_integration/test_extraction.py -k qwen35 -x -q`: 2 passed, LBNHC and BLHNC, using FlashAttention explicitly.
- `~/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/extract_hidden_states_integration/test_extraction.py -k glm5next -x -s -q`: 2 passed, reduced GLM with dummy weights on MRV1 and MRV2. Remote runs used `chg run --gpus 1`, with `~/.venv/bin` and `/usr/local/cuda/bin` on PATH.
- Unmodified main `258b97ff6b` passed full GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 extraction on 4 B300 GPUs, TP4, MRV2, through Speculators: all 40 requests passed, including 20 byte-exact comparisons against references from the same execution. Captured layers: 5/22/43/45, prefix caching disabled, prompt lengths 8–1,921 tokens. Extraction selected graph mode `NONE`.
- Separate full-model starts on that same main commit reported the following observed capacities. Both used 85% GPU memory utilization, max model length 4,096, max batched tokens 512, max sequences 4, and BLHNC. Pure inference also passed a generation request.

| Server-log measurement | Pure inference | Hidden-state extraction |
|---|---:|---:|
| KV token capacity | 5,196,003 | 1,027,855 |
| Available KV memory per GPU | 149.48 GiB | 150.38 GiB |

Extraction retains 19.8% of the observed pure-inference capacity. Read the `Available KV cache memory` and `GPU KV cache size` startup log lines to observe these values. The small memory-budget difference reflects graph and activation reservations. These are cache-capacity measurements, not throughput measurements.

- Prior branch validation used the full GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 checkpoint on four B300 GPUs through Speculators: 40 requests passed with automatic graph selection, including 20 byte-exact comparisons against references from the same execution with graph replay verified. Those results predate this rebase.

## Details

The auxiliary-state capture and generic packed-layout prerequisites (#56983 and #57169) are merged and excluded from this diff. Main now contains the underlying extraction support, but packed hidden-state pages retain the native token block size and can inflate the shared cache stride. MRV2 also misses breakable graph availability when resolving cache-only attention's graph mode.

Reuse the existing divisor helper and logical tensor indexing. Regression coverage checks GLM-shaped cache sizing, native-page isolation, strided extraction, and mixed-length concurrent requests. The minimum hidden-state block is one token, so a single token larger than the native page still increases the stride. No steady-state synchronization is added.

Full-checkpoint results cover prompt extraction with prefix caching disabled. Generated-token extraction and performance remain unvalidated. AI assistance was used.

---
